name: abc_flags_golden
title: ABC flags equal the frozen golden list
protects: Every ABC flag (id, type, severity, period, subject, observed values, basis) against tests/golden/abc_flags.expected.json, which a human reviewed. Any added, removed or changed flag fails. Not a PLAN case id: PLAN 8.1 folds flags into G01 (L1); a separate case reports a flag regression on its own line.
